summary: Your site works folded, but the page spills sideways and the header covers the booking button once the phone is opened.

findings.title: The page scrolls sideways on the unfolded screen
findings.detail: Content sits 74px wider than the screen at 890 x 626, so the whole page can be dragged left and right. The gallery row is the widest thing on the page.

findings.title: The sticky header covers the booking button
findings.detail: The header keeps its 96px mobile height on the unfolded screen and overlaps the Book an appointment button, which sits 62px from the top of the page.

findings.title: A breakpoint lands inside the folded width
findings.detail: A media query switches layout at 480px, which is inside the folded screen's 466px band. Small changes to text size flip the page between two layouts.

findings.title: The hero is sized with 100vh
findings.detail: The opening panel is 100vh tall, so on the short unfolded screen the practice name and the phone number sit below the first screenful.

findings.title: Two links are close together in split view
findings.detail: The opening hours links are 28px apart in the footer at 440px wide, which is tight for a thumb.

findings.title: The slider does not re-measure when the phone opens
findings.detail: The homepage slider reads its width once on load. After the fold it keeps the folded width and leaves a blank column on the right.
evidence: no resize listener bound by slick.min.js

findings.title: Text stays readable at every size
findings.detail: Body text renders at 16px or more on all three screens, with no forced zoom.

findings.title: The viewport tag is set correctly
findings.detail: width=device-width, initial-scale=1 is present, so the page uses the real screen width rather than a fixed one.

findings.title: Images scale with the layout
findings.detail: Every image on the page is fluid, so nothing forces the layout wider than the screen on its own.

findings.title: Built on WordPress
findings.detail: The fixes below are CSS in your theme plus one small script, so nothing needs rebuilding.

foldTransition.note: After the phone is opened the page keeps most of its folded layout until it is reloaded: the slider stays narrow and the gallery row is still the folded width.

viewports.label: Folded
viewports.description: The outer screen, held upright. Wider than any earlier iPhone, but short.

viewports.label: Unfolded
viewports.description: The inner screen opened flat. Tablet width, phone height.

viewports.label: Split View
viewports.description: Half of the inner screen, with two apps side by side.

emulationNote: Emulated at the iPhone Duo's screen sizes in a WebKit browser. Real hardware ships 23 October 2026; we will re-run every check on a real device then.
